title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
claim: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search — The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor C
why_good: A local, on-your-machine AI job-search framework (evaluate postings, tailor applications) — privacy-first appeal for a painful, high-volume task.
value: Mid-career switchers in a single national market paying for a structured month of search; the interview-rehearsal half is the only part that survives the hire.
risk: A first-party 'job search' skill from the model vendor reduces this to prompts; churn-on-success caps lifetime value.

zh.claim: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search —— 跑在你自己机器上的 AI 求职框架(基于 Claude Code):评估岗位、定制申请。
zh.why_good: 一个本地、在你机器上跑的 AI 求职框架(评估岗位、定制申请)——对一个痛苦、高频的任务主打隐私优先。
zh.value: 单一市场里的中期转行者，为「一个月有章法的求职」付费；面试演练是唯一能活过入职那天的部分。
zh.risk: 模型厂商自己出一个「求职」skill，它就退化成 prompt；「一成功就流失」封死终身价值。
zh.hook: 一位被裁的地球物理学家拿它跑了自己的求职——69 份定制申请、20 场初面、1 份签下的合同——之后 9,800 人 fork 了它，相当于 star 数的三分之一。
zh.does: 一套把 fork 变成求职流水线的 Claude Code 工作流：`/setup` 建立个人档案，`/scrape` 抓岗位，`/apply` 用「起草—评审」双角色循环产出简历与求职信，`/interview` 陪你演练。核心流程与国家无关，但自带的招聘平台技能是丹麦的（Jobindex、Jobnet、Akademikernes Jobbank）。
zh.gap: 本土市场是空的，打包方式又只面向开发者：流程本身通用，平台技能却是丹麦专用；而且要用它就得 fork 仓库、在终端里驱动 Claude Code。
zh.counter: 把脚手架拆掉，它本质是一叠 prompt——Anthropic 上线一个求职 skill，这个仓库就只剩 README。它还继承了整个品类的致命形状：最好的客户因为成功而流失，LinkedIn 手握岗位、关系图和免费的匹配分，而作者的战绩只是 n=1 的样本。
zh.differentiator: 只取不骚扰雇主的那一半——匹配评分与面试演练——为一个非英语市场做成托管版，按「一次求职周期」而不是按投递份数收费。
zh.consumer_angle: 这本来就是普通人的事；缺的是一个被裁的非开发者不用 fork 任何东西就能打开的版本。

hook: A geophysicist whose position was cut ran this on his own search — 69 tailored applications, 20 first interviews, one signed contract — and 9,800 people have forked it since, a third of everyone who starred it.
pick_reason: The project addresses a significant pain point in job searching with a privacy-first approach, showing strong community interest and potential for monetization.
does: A Claude Code workflow that turns a fork into a job-application pipeline: `/setup` builds your profile, `/scrape` pulls postings, `/apply` runs a drafter–reviewer loop over CV and cover letter, `/interview` rehearses you. The core workflow is country-agnostic; the shipped portal skills target Denmark (Jobindex, Jobnet, Akademikernes Jobbank).
gap: The local-market case is empty and the packaging is developer-only: the workflow is generic but the portal skills are Danish, and using it at all means forking a repo and driving Claude Code from a terminal.
counter: Strip the scaffolding and this is a folder of prompts — Anthropic ships one job-search skill and the repo becomes a README. It also inherits the category's fatal shape: your best customers churn by succeeding, LinkedIn owns the postings, the graph and a free match score, and the author's own results are a sample of one.
differentiator: Take the half that does not spam employers — fit scoring and interview rehearsal — host it for one non-English market, and charge per active search rather than per application.
consumer_angle: Already a consumer job: what is missing is the version a laid-off non-developer can open without forking anything.
